notes.title: NGA 2023 update
notes.content:
Just in time for NGA 2023 😎

[list]
[*]  Chase distance reduced for skeletons (for the sake of game balance)
[*]  Gallery automatically enters pages
[*]  Fixed a bug where infinite players would spawn on game end
[*]  Made player control of a turret be first-come first-served until that player gives up control
[*]  Made camera change to perspective from orthogonal on game end for more visual flare in the effect
[*] UI wheel now also has a toggle button
[*] A short controller/input tutorial now plays at the start of a round
[*] A short skippable intro movie is shown when game is booted up
[/list]
